actions.name: Sent invoice-themed phishing emails to US election officials
actions.description: On 5 October 2021, unidentified cyber actors targeted US election officials in at least nine states, and representatives of the National Association of Secretaries of State, with phishing emails containing links to credential-harvesting websites.

actions.name: Sent phishing emails with Microsoft Word invoice attachments to county election employees
actions.description: On 18 October 2021, cyber actors used two email addresses, purportedly from US businesses, to send phishing emails to county election employees.
